_source: Positions derived from the official Dublin High School Campus Map image (data/schools/dhs/campus_map.jpg). Cardinal directions use the map's own orientation: top=north, bottom=south (Village Pkwy edge), left=west (Iron Horse Trail / fields edge), right=east (Brighton Dr edge). The map image is tilted relative to true north, but these directions match what a user sees when they look at the campus map.

C.name: VAPA / Performing Arts building (Building C)
C.position: Center-south of campus. The Performing Arts Center is directly attached on its south side; the Auxiliary Gym (Building E) is to the north and the tennis courts are to the west.
C.notes: Houses music, drama, and media arts (VAPA wing); directly attached to the Performing Arts Center.

E.name: Auxiliary Gym (Building E)
E.position: Center-west of campus, north of VAPA (Building C) and west of Building H; the portables (relocatable classrooms) are just to the west.
E.notes: Separate from GAEL Stadium's field house; across the central plaza from Building H.

F.name: Science & Engineering (Building F)
F.position: East side of campus, south of the Sports Complex and north of the ARC; Parking Lots 5 and 6 sit east along Brighton Drive.
F.notes: The ARC (Academic Resource Center) is directly adjacent on the south side.

H.name: Building H
H.position: Center of campus, immediately west of the Student Union; south of the ARC and east of the central plaza.

J.name: Building J
J.position: East side of campus along Brighton Drive, north of Building K; Parking Lot 5 sits directly east between the building and Brighton Dr.

K.name: Building K
K.position: East side of campus along Brighton Drive, south of Building J; Parking Lot 5 sits directly east between the building and Brighton Dr.

L.name: Building L
L.position: South-east of campus — easternmost of the south building row (west-to-east the row goes N → M → L). Closest of the three to Brighton Drive.

M.name: Building M
M.position: South-center of campus — middle of the south building row, between Building N on the west and Building L on the east.

N.name: Building N
N.position: South-center of campus — westernmost of the south building row (N → M → L west-to-east), next to Building M on the east.

Admin.position: Center-south of campus, directly south of the Library in the central plaza.
Admin.description: Main administration office in the central plaza, south of the Library.

Library.position: Center of campus, in the central plaza — north of Admin and east of the Amphitheater.
Library.description: Library, in the central plaza between Admin (south) and the Amphitheater (west).

Student Union.position: Center-east of campus, east of Building H and west of Buildings J/K.
Student Union.description: Student Union / dining area, east of Building H.

Performing Arts Center.position: Center-south of campus, directly attached to the south side of Building C (VAPA).
Performing Arts Center.description: Performing Arts Center (PAC), directly attached to Building C (VAPA) on its south side.

Amphitheater.position: Center of campus, in the plaza between the VAPA / Performing Arts cluster (west) and the Library / Student Union (east).
Amphitheater.description: Outdoor amphitheater in the central plaza, between the VAPA building and the Library.

Sports Complex.position: North-east of campus, south of GAEL Stadium and north of Building F; adjacent to Parking Lot 6.
Sports Complex.description: Sports Complex, between GAEL Stadium (north) and Building F (south).

GAEL Stadium.position: North edge of campus (top-center of the map), with the football field and surrounding red track. The Iron Horse Trail runs along the west edge beyond the fields; the Stadium itself is east of the trail.
GAEL Stadium.description: Football stadium and track at the north edge of campus.

Baseball & Softball Diamonds.position: West half of campus along the Iron Horse Trail. The baseball diamond (larger) is center-west, south of GAEL Stadium; the softball diamond (smaller) is in the south-west corner.
Baseball & Softball Diamonds.description: Baseball diamond on the west side (center-west, south of the stadium) and softball diamond in the SW corner.

Tennis Courts.position: Center-west of campus, south of the baseball field and west of the portables / VAPA cluster.
Tennis Courts.description: Tennis courts, between the baseball field and the central building cluster.

ARC.building: Academic Resource Center (adjacent to Building F)
ARC.position: East side of campus, directly south of Building F.
ARC.description: Academic Resource Center, directly south of (and adjacent to) Building F.

parking.Lot 1: South edge of campus — westernmost lot along Village Parkway.
parking.Lot 2: South edge of campus, along Village Parkway between Lots 1 and 3.
parking.Lot 3: South edge of campus, along Village Parkway between Lots 2 and 4.
parking.Lot 4: South edge of campus — easternmost lot along Village Parkway, directly south of Buildings N / M / L.
parking.Lot 5: East side of campus, between the Student Union / Buildings J-K cluster and Brighton Drive.
parking.Lot 6: North-east corner of campus, along Brighton Drive next to the Sports Complex.

navigation_notes: Cardinal reference (using the campus map image's orientation): Village Parkway runs along the south edge; Brighton Drive runs along the east edge; the Iron Horse Trail runs along the west / north-west edge; GAEL Stadium sits at the north edge.

The west half of campus is almost entirely athletic fields: GAEL Stadium at the north (football + 'D'-logo turf + red track), the baseball diamond center-west, and the softball diamond in the south-west corner — all three next to the Iron Horse Trail.

The main building cluster is on the east half of the campus. Running top-to-bottom on the east side: Sports Complex, then Building F (Science & Engineering), then the ARC — with Parking Lots 5 and 6 along Brighton Drive to their east.
Buildings J and K sit on the east edge along Brighton Drive, with Parking Lot 5 between them and the street; J is the northerly one, K is directly south.

The center-west of the building cluster has the portables (relocatable classrooms), Building E (Auxiliary Gym) just east of the portables, Building C (VAPA) south of E with the Performing Arts Center attached on its south side, and the tennis courts further west.
The central plaza runs north-south through the center: Amphitheater → Library → Admin from north to south, with Building H and the Student Union just east of the plaza.

Buildings N, M, and L form the south row of the main building area (west-to-east: N → M → L — L is the easternmost, closest to Brighton Drive). Parking Lot 4 sits directly south of this row along Village Parkway.

Parking: Lots 1-4 run west-to-east along Village Parkway at the south edge; Lot 5 is on the east side between the main building cluster and Brighton Drive; Lot 6 is in the north-east corner next to the Sports Complex.
